collection_method: Load and validate the exact frozen query pack before collection.
For every entity and field, inspect only the entity's allowed official source roots before considering the field unproven.
Retrieve each distinct source once per run where possible and record its actual retrieval timestamp.
Record a field-specific section, heading, selector, API property, or bounded passage locator; navigation labels and search snippets alone cannot prove a claim.
Use proven only when the cited locator directly supports the normalized value for that entity and field.
Use unproven when the bounded official-source inspection does not establish the atom; do not infer false or not-disclosed from absence.
Use conflicted only with two distinct verified source URLs and explicit opposing source notes.
Use not_applicable only where the query pack allows it.

For pricing, populate structured facts only when currency, VAT state, billing/unit context, and at least one qualifying tier are supported; otherwise preserve supported partial context in the evidence note and mark the field unproven.
Validate schema, roster, field coverage, evidence ownership, source roots, timestamps, and pack binding before publication.
source_priority: explicitly allowed independent evidence when the query pack permits it
